title: Internal exception messages are returned to authenticated clients
reasoning: The route catches every exception from generation and exposes the raw exception text in the HTTP response. Generation touches database state and provider/task setup, so exception messages can disclose filesystem paths, SQL details, configuration values, or upstream error text. Even behind API-key auth, 500 responses should be generic and detailed diagnostics should go to logs.
reproduction: Force podcast_service.generate_scheduled_episode to raise RuntimeError("sensitive path /secret/config"), then POST /api/podcast/episodes/generate; the response body includes that message.
recommendation: Log the exception with exc_info and return a generic error detail such as "Podcast generation failed". Map known expected failures to explicit 4xx/503 responses without reflecting raw exception strings.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There is no direct test for /podcast/episodes/generate error handling, and existing tests do not assert that internal exception text is hidden from responses.
suggestedRegressionTest: Monkeypatch generate_scheduled_episode to raise an exception containing a sentinel secret, POST /podcast/episodes/generate, assert status 500, and assert the sentinel is absent from response.json()["detail"].
minimumFixScope: Change the exception handler in generate_podcast_now and add a focused API regression test.
